title: The Quantization Benefits of Residual-Free Transformers
abstract: arXiv:2605.25880v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large-scale transformer training and deployment are increasingly constrained by the transfer of activations, gradients, and optimizer states across accelerators. Low-bit quantization offers a natural remedy, but transformer activations are often heavy-tailed and outlier-dominated, making simple quantization highly lossy. We show that this difficulty is not only a property of the quantizer, but also of the architecture. Specifically, residual connections can drive transformer activations away from Gaussianity during training. Using controlled comparisons between residual and residual-free transformers, we demonstrate that this effect leads to substantially higher quantization error and accuracy degradation at low precision in residual models. translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.25880v2 公告类型：replace 摘要：大规模Transformer的训练与部署日益受到激活值、梯度和优化器状态在加速器之间传输的制约。低比特量化为这一问题提供了天然的解决方案，但Transformer的激活值通常呈重尾分布且被离群值主导，使得简单的量化方法带来严重的信息损失。我们表明，这一困难不仅源于量化器本身，也源于架构本身。具体而言，残差连接会在训练过程中使Transformer的激活值偏离高斯分布。通过对残差与无残差Transformer的受控对比实验，我们证明这一效应导致残差模型在低精度下产生显著更高的量化误差和精度下降。我们通过超额峰度分析解释了这一现象，指出残差混合会放大激活值的非高斯性，而无残差模型中的稠密混合则会收缩非高斯性。
tldr: 本文揭示了残差连接会在训练中放大Transformer激活值的非高斯性（重尾、离群值主导），从而加剧低比特量化的误差与精度损失，而无残差Transformer凭借稠密混合收缩非高斯性，在量化部署中具有天然优势。
en_tdlr: Residual connections amplify non-Gaussianity in transformer activations during training, leading to substantially higher quantization error at low precision, whereas residual-free transformers with dense mixing contract non-Gaussianity and thus enjoy significant quantization benefits.
